title: Restore the unclipped photon target after statistical clipping
statement: Each IID block uses two bright plus one dark TWO-channel records. DifferenceD=Ya−Yb andM=(Ya+Yb)/2−Ydark give eight real coordinates. Externally bounded conditional count means admit independent fixed Poisson dominators; whole-block cutoff bias is charged back to the UNCLIPPED target.

requires: Conditional independent Poisson law with externally acquired count-MEAN ceilings, fixedN>=2/cutoffs/coder and IID blocks or paid coupling plus valid total failure budgets.
provides: Each IID block uses two bright plus one dark TWO-channel records. DifferenceD=Ya−Yb andM=(Ya+Yb)/2−Ydark give eight real coordinates. Externally bounded conditional count means admit independent fixed Poisson dominators; whole-block cutoff bias is charged back to the UNCLIPPED target.
assumptions: Observed maxima are not caps; random backgrounds, deadtime or post-data multiple runs are not qualified.
costs: Charge the actually supplied physical source, preparation/reset, calibration, record/archive/randomness and full-cycle operations. Algebraic scalar calls or source software timings are not physical bits, measured throughput or wall-plug work. Equally informed ordinary methods may use the same inputs and operations; no complete-resource advantage established.
contract.units: All model quantities retain their supplied units: dimensionless channel probabilities/cycle log rate ratios/model fields; photon counts, seconds/rates, pressure and mechanical work require actual source calibration. Distinct clocks, records, dose, energy and source-work conventions are not interchanged.
contract.obstruction: Observed maxima are not caps; random backgrounds, deadtime or post-data multiple runs are not qualified. No newly acquired physical source law, detector/channel calibration, uniform drive bus, loaded composed device, chemistry, practical advantage or historical priority. Producer scripts/large saved checks are preserved as source evidence, not rerun. Chemistry full numerical proof/program archives remain UNACQUIRED/DEFERRED. Mission NOT_ACHIEVED.

body: Zero a whole block when either count exceeds its predeclared cutoff, retain it inN, and validate every event even in clipped blocks. Poisson factorial-moment tail bounds control means, diagonal and offdiagonal biases. Eight shared-data empirical-Bernstein intervals need simultaneous coverage, not independent estimators. Coding adds eta/2eta bounds. All coupling/preparation/tail errors are TOTAL-dataset budgets. Statistical clipping does not physically preserve the cone by itself.
